runtimeMapping.movement: sourceMoveRespawn carries selected self kill stacks, source-owned Abyssal grants and deck effects; rebuilds active S3 modifiers; assigns captured HP ratio against reconstructed MAX_HP; preserves skill activation and remaining time. Other resident temporary buffs are detached. This explicit local policy is not native C# lifecycle parity.
runtimeMapping.reservation: Source footprint has EmptyAnimator and zero slots; reserve origin without inventing a combat chibi.
runtimeMapping.clock: Original facing clips and capped attack clocks drive release; S3 uses Begin .433 emission, ReStart_A/B, End .333 and Back .833. S1 uses a live INPUT2 set, speed10 flight, linear second-part capture over1.3s, a minimum1s link and1s post-delay. Closed native dispatch remains a bounded local interpretation.
runtimeMapping.damageReceipt: First-talent healing reads current HP after an accepted mitigated/shield receipt, ignores cancelled hits and direct HP loss, and obeys HealFree. Native lethal receipt/event ordering is not certified.
runtimeMapping.anchor: Select first forward ground target's integer root tile, otherwise farthest in-map range6-1 tile; blast applies stun then physical damage before attempted move. Occupied/nondeployable endpoints refuse movement without suppressing the blast. Exact swept-body selector and native fallback are not recovered.
runtimeMapping.return: Release the zero-slot origin marker, hold S3 stats through End, restore home HP ratio and clear SP, then play Back. In-place return also advances the local lifetime. True death/retreat never returns or resurrects the owner.

verificationLimits: TileSelector filter28 exact first-target/max-forward/fallback tile ordering; official selected description supports only the primary first-hit-or-max-distance rule. Existing inherited second-next-tile fallback and wall-stop law comes from secondary PRTS, not serialized selector proof.
Projectile extraActionEvent3 versus damage/stun/respawn execution ordering is mapped locally as stun, physical damage, then move; native C# dispatch is not recovered.
Native RespawnBegin deadline, coincident callbacks and forceRespawnInPlace arbitration are unrecovered. Source clocks are retained; local return advances a lifetime even when already home.

S1 capture-net physics and postFilter10 priority are unrecovered. Local route-progress targeting, linear timed pull through shared displacement geometry and minimum link/post clocks are tested approximations, not once-immediate pull or game-frame parity.

Resident buff cleanup is an explicit local policy, not proven native wholesale transfer. Source Abyssal rebirth-detach exception and emitted S1 output survive source move/removal as mapped; elemental/memory fields and other native born passives are not reconstructed.
Native Unity particles, audio, modules and game-frame parity remain unfinished.
sourceContracts: Native crusher selectors WALK/NORMAL cap to current block capacity, include unblocked in-range targets by established source bridge; normal Attack .533, S2 Loop .7, S3 Loop .633, cap1 and exact facing aliases retained.

First talent ON_TAKE_DAMAGE checks current source HP ratio vs selected hp_ratio. FixedValueHeal uses value1/value2 and ignoreHealFree=false. S2 talent holder explicitly scales only value1/value2 by selected talent_scale.

Second talent own source kill creates MAX_HP/ATK ADDITION stacks capped selected9/10; global Abyssal buff is source-owned/derived and checks source/owner stack gap, first tick .04 then1s. Actual friendly target-free predicate is not replaced by a healing predicate.

S1 INPUT2/timing0/alwaysIncludeTarget1; selected cap2 WALK selector postFilter10, source Circle radius.8, exact 3-2 range. Real link projectile speed10, max lifetime1.3/linkDuration1, source-owned false, second pull part1.3 and offset.5; native capture-net versus ordinary pull dispatch not recovered.
S2 selected ATK/MAX_HP PERCENTAGE and BLOCK_COUNT ADDITION; infinite switch_mode buff, native .167 Begin and own .7 attack event.

S3 selected ATK/MAX_HP copied into attack@ulpia_s3_respawn_buff via literal preprocessing. Selector28 SELF1/timing0/alwaysIncludeTarget0/range6-1; ground endpoint area speed15, stop maxHit1/onlyCheckWhenReach/goThroughWall1, selected scalable radius1.8.

S3 impact action event3 checks skill still affecting then RespawnCharacter forceRespawnInPlace=true, shared row/col, preserve specific shared BB keys for skill progress, original tile, alive, kill stack count and HP ratio. Successful action spawns selected token from cards on shared original located tile.

S3 original holder is manually discardable, restoreAbility is native RespawnBegin alias with no serialized actions; native root supplies custom move/return behavior. Exact scripted phases cannot be replaced by simple stat buffs.

HP sync checks death reason MOVE_LIKE_RESPAWN_SELF, stores HP ratio on finish then reads ratio on birth; T2 stores selected self-stack count only on this move reason and resets it on other finishes. The graph explicitly names carry state; wholesale foreign-buff cleanup remains a native implementation assumption, not proven by these nodes alone.

S3 born switches to ReStart_A/B based on respawn-in-place. BuffAbility creates selected ATK/MAX_HP and force-clears SP plus derived SP_RECOVER_STOPPED; return uses Back clip and restore mode, source clears SP again.

Footprint token original category2/zero slot/EmptyAnimator/no Spine/no attack. Passive creates dynamic-tile exclude marker and keep_tile_option1. Source abnormal flags5/15 and immunity0/16/23 retained with enum uncertainty; no rendered model invented.

neededSharedContracts.reason: Current moveRedeploy intentionally keeps all state. Need an opt-in source move transaction with explicit capture/rebirth and adapter-selected carry policy; graph-proven HP ratio, skill progress and self-stack state must carry. Whether other resident buffs/controls reset requires an approved bounded interpretation; source detach/remove-on-reborning flags must be handled separately and cannot justify a blanket aura wipe.

Exact original footprint occupies old tile with zero slots and owner-exclusion dynamic tile state. Reserve until return/real withdrawal/death, release reservation before return, prevent foreign occupation, refresh block/range/spatial state at each valid landing without mutating global deployment limit.
